title: SWS: 51% of Filipinos satisfied with VP Duterte's performance

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte continued to post the highest net satisfaction rating among four top government officials, despite a 10-point decline, according to a Social Weather Stations (SWS) survey. The SWS conducted the survey from Sept. 21 to 27 through face-to-face interviews with 1,500 Filipino adults ages 18 and older nationwide. The survey found that 51% of Filipinos were satisfied with Duterte’s performance as vice president, while 30% were dissatisfied.
